title: Subcontracting Operation Notes
summary: Subcontracting operations now support dedicated comments at the standard task, routing line, and production order routing line levels, which flow to subcontracting purchase orders as attached blank lines while production-order attachments flow to related purchase lines.
key_points: New comment tables and pages for standard tasks, routing lines, and production order routing lines
Comments and attachments flow to subcontracting purchase orders as blank lines
Comments are restricted to subcontracting operations only
Production-order comments are scoped by output line to prevent mixing vendor instructions in Family orders
Document Attachment Details integration event updated with PurchaseDocumentFlow parameter
quote: Adds dedicated subcontracting comments at the Standard Task, Routing Line, and Production Order Routing Line levels.
